scripts.setup: npm install && uv sync --directory apps/api && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @chatbotator/web && uv run --directory apps/api mypy
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check
